Privileges.description_en: When custom permissions are granted to a user for a database, privileges returns the custom permission content separated by commas (,). Otherwise, privileges does not return data
Privileges.description_zh: 用户授予数据库自定义权限时，privileges 返回自定义的权限内容，以逗号 "," 分割；其余时间 privileges 不返回数据

Role.description_en:
The granted role. For Oracle mode, roles are at the schema level. Valid values: ReadWrite: read and write permissions, including CREATE TABLE CREATE VIEW CREATE PROCEDURE CREATE SYNONYM CREATE SEQUENCE CREATE TRIGGER CREATE TYPE CREATE SESSION EXECUTE ANY PROCEDURE CREATE ANY OUTLINE ALTER ANY OUTLINE DROP ANY OUTLINE CREATE ANY PROCEDURE ALTER ANY PROCEDURE DROP ANY PROCEDURE CREATE ANY SEQUENCE ALTER ANY SEQUENCE DROP ANY SEQUENCE CREATE ANY TYPE ALTER ANY TYPE DROP ANY TYPE SYSKM CREATE ANY TRIGGER ALTER ANY TRIGGER DROP ANY TRIGGER CREATE PROFILE ALTER PROFILE DROP PROFILE. ReadOnly: read-only permission, including SELECT. For MySQL mode, roles are at the database level. Valid values: ReadWrite: read and write permissions, including ALL PRIVILEGES. ReadOnly: read-only permission, including SELECT. DDL: DDL permissions, including CREATE, DROP, ALTER, SHOW VIEW, CREATE VIEW. DML: DML permissions, including SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, SHOW VIEW.
In addition, an Oracle account has default read and write permissions on its own schema, which are not listed here
Role.description_zh:
拥有的角色。 对于 Oracle 模式，角色为 schema 级别，其可分为 ReadWrite：读写权限，包括 CREATE TABLE CREATE VIEW CREATE PROCEDURE CREATE SYNONYM CREATE SEQUENCE CREATE TRIGGER CREATE TYPE CREATE SESSION EXECUTE ANY PROCEDURE CREATE ANY OUTLINE ALTER ANY OUTLINE DROP ANY OUTLINE CREATE ANY PROCEDURE ALTER ANY PROCEDURE DROP ANY PROCEDURE CREATE ANY SEQUENCE ALTER ANY SEQUENCE DROP ANY SEQUENCE CREATE ANY TYPE ALTER ANY TYPE DROP ANY TYPE SYSKM CREATE ANY TRIGGER ALTER ANY TRIGGER DROP ANY TRIGGER CREATE PROFILE ALTER PROFILE DROP PROFILE； ReadOnly：只读权限，SELECT 对于MySQL模式，角色为数据库（Database）级别，其有以下几类： ReadWrite：读写权限，包括 ALL PRIVILEGES； ReadOnly：只读权限，包括 SELECT； DDL: DDL 权限，包括 CREATE,DROP,ALTER,SHOW VIEW,CREATE VIEW； DML: DML 权限，包括 SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,SHOW VIEW。
另外， Oracle 账户对自己的 Schema 有默认的读写权限，此处不会列出
Role.title_zh:
拥有的角色。 对于Oracle模式，角色为schema级别，其可分为 - ReadWrite：读写权限，包括CREATE TABLE CREATE VIEW CREATE PROCEDURE CREATE SYNONYM CREATE SEQUENCE CREATE TRIGGER CREATE TYPE CREATE SESSION EXECUTE ANY PROCEDURE CREATE ANY OUTLINE ALTER ANY OUTLINE DROP ANY OUTLINE CREATE ANY PROCEDURE ALTER ANY PROCEDURE DROP ANY PROCEDURE CREATE ANY SEQUENCE ALTER ANY SEQUENCE DROP ANY SEQUENCE CREATE ANY TYPE ALTER ANY TYPE DROP ANY TYPE SYSKM CREATE ANY TRIGGER ALTER ANY TRIGGER DROP ANY TRIGGER CREATE PROFILE ALTER PROFILE DROP PROFILE； - ReadOnly：只读权限，SELECT
对于MySQL模式，角色为数据库（Database）级别，其有以下几类： - ReadWrite：读写权限，包括ALL PRIVILEGES； - ReadOnly：只读权限，包括SELECT - DDL: DDL权限，包括CREATE,DROP,ALTER,SHOW VIEW,CREATE VIEW - DML: DML权限，包括SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,SHOW VIEW。
另外Oracle账户对自己的schema有默认的读写权限，这里不会列出。
